authority: Only fixed Git objects from the new approved worktrees; old expression-reuse trees not inspected or used.

methodology.unit: One logical function/operator/explicit AST computation family after documented alias/synthetic-overload normalization.
methodology.counting: One family across AST/typed/PB/batch/helper/cop paths. Cast source-target and date-unit signatures are overloads, not separate counts. Whole supported baseline domain required for full migration.
methodology.exclusions: Host-only/binding/type-metadata primitives, constant leaves, structural ROW, unavailable/never-implemented registry names and LOAD_FILE always-NULL compatibility stub.
methodology.conservative_mixed_policy: RAND (including dynamic deterministic seed), clocks/NOW/UTC/SYSDATE, TIDB_BOUNDED_STALENESS, UNIX_TIMESTAMP, JSON_SCHEMA_VALID and VALIDATE_PASSWORD_STRENGTH retain counted pure domains with explicit host subdomains; context sensitivity never automatically excludes a family.
methodology.static_evidence_limit: Source admission/dispatch/definition and test declarations only. No builds, Cargo metadata, test runs or exhaustive domain/oracle measurements. Lexical links are not test coverage.
methodology.negated_syntax_rule: NOT IN/BETWEEN/LIKE/IS forms retain negative variant domain under base family plus NOT operator; variants are not asserted identical results.
methodology.provenance: Generator reads SHA:path Git objects, so concurrent edits by implementation agents cannot silently redefine baseline.

operator_numeric.type_domains: Typed Int (signed/unsigned), Real and Decimal numeric lanes; AST datum-driven coercions; bitwise/shift use integer conversion. Hybrid YEAR/BIT/ENUM/SET, numeric binary-literal provenance and NULL branches are overload facts, not interchangeable text.
context_domains: overflow/truncation policy and diagnostic expression text
operator_numeric.collation_domains: Numeric lane itself is not collation-sensitive; string/hybrid casts and literal provenance still matter.

comparison.type_domains: Int signedness, Real, Decimal, String, Time/Duration, Json, VectorFloat32 and row-valued comparison routing are source-defined; not a claim that every pair is accepted by every operator. NULL-safe equality, IN NULL mask, typed GREATEST/LEAST and lazy INTERVAL are distinct domains.
context_domains: IN constant cache versus dynamic candidates
comparison.collation_domains: String lanes use derived collator; AST value-only/default derivation differs. Legacy/new mode and all registered native collators are frozen obligations where reachable, not a proven Cartesian product.

control.type_domains: Nullable truthiness and selected result Datum; typed control result is shaped by merged FieldType, while AST returns natural branch Datum. PB supported result types are enumerated per row, not assumed complete.
control.collation_domains: Selected string results retain inferred charset/collation; condition casts may be numeric.

math.type_domains: Numeric arguments through native numeric_arg/coercion; ABS/SIGN/CEIL/FLOOR/ROUND/TRUNCATE have source/result-type-specific integer/unsigned/real/decimal branches; transcendental functions use ETReal. Exact per-value bounds live in the referenced fixed source.
math.collation_domains: No comparison collation; string-to-number/bytes conversion remains source-sensitive.

string.type_domains: String/Bytes plus function-specific ETString/ETInt coercion; binary versus UTF8 unit signatures, optional position/length/locale, hybrid inputs, and malformed UTF8 handling differ by operation. NULL and packet-overflow paths are included.
string.collation_domains: StrUnits byte versus rune selection is not collation equality. LOCATE/INSTR/STRCMP/FIELD/FIND_IN_SET/WEIGHT_STRING use appropriate collator; other operations preserve bytes or character semantics. See global collation catalog.

pattern.type_domains: Nullable sql_bytes/sql_string operands; LIKE/ILIKE escape byte, wildcard and invalid-octet behavior; REGEXP pattern, match type, optional position/occurrence/return option/replacement. Binary and Unicode domains are not assumed equivalent.
context_domains: deferred pattern failure in unused branch
pattern.collation_domains: LIKE uses datum/default or derived collator and byte/rune mode; REGEXP derives match type from collation. All collation/pattern/input cross-products remain dynamically unverified.

temporal.type_domains: Typed Date/Datetime/Timestamp, Duration, string/numeric sources and source FieldType (especially YEAR); interval units, FSP and result shape selected by each function. AST often returns strings while typed paths parse computed Time/Duration. No universal timezone/zero-date/SQL-mode compatibility claim.
temporal.collation_domains: Temporal parsing/formatting generally textual rather than collator-based; source charset conversion still applies.

json.type_domains: BinaryJSON/document text, scalars, path expressions and typed SQL-to-JSON constructors; JSON null differs from SQL NULL; opaque binary-charset values exist on typed path. Each path wildcard/cardinality/error rule is source-defined. Full object/numeric/temporal domains are not inferred from dispatch.
context_domains: path/schema metadata caching keyed to statement
json.collation_domains: JSON comparison/encoding is separate from SQL collator order; string-valued arguments still have charset/provenance.

vector.type_domains: VectorFloat32 or native parsed textual vector according to function; dimensions and distance/norm overflow/NaN behavior are source-defined. Not a claim of all scalar-to-vector casts.
vector.collation_domains: No vector comparator collation; textual conversion input is still a string domain.

cast.type_domains: One family containing all explicit/implicit casts: Signed, Unsigned, UnsignedInUnion, Char, Binary, Decimal, Date, DateTime, Year, Double, Float, Vector, Time, Json. Synthetic source-specific in-union names are overloads, not extra families; all PB source/target pairs listed separately.
context_domains: source and full target FieldType flags/width/scale/FSP
cast.collation_domains: Binary/character targets differ in padding, truncation unit, encoding and errors. No Cartesian source-target matrix is certified.

convert_charset.type_domains: Explicit CONVERT USING plus synthetic to_binary/from_binary. Legacy utf8/utf8mb4/ascii/latin1/binary bypass differs from nonlegacy encoding; explicit decode/replace and implicit error semantics differ.
convert_charset.collation_domains: Charset encode/decode, not SQL comparison; supported encoding catalog is distinct from collation catalog.

crypto.type_domains: Byte-string coercion, digest/compression/encoding/AES variants; AES key-size/mode/IV and SHA2 length are overload axes. Password validation also consumes host configuration; that is explicitly mixed rather than dropping this family.
context_domains: password policy/global vars and identities for validation
crypto.collation_domains: Binary-aware argument transcoding precedes byte kernels; collation comparison is not the digest algorithm.

network.type_domains: IPv4/IPv6 byte/text parsing, integer network-order conversion and NULL; exact malformed-string forms source-defined.
context_domains: numeric cast warning policy for INET_NTOA
network.collation_domains: ASCII/byte format validation, not collator equality.

misc.type_domains: Per-family deterministic value/metadata kernel: identity, UUID transforms, numeric formatting, TiDB-specific pure encoding/hash, or GROUPING mask with bound metadata. See dispatch/function extents for exact domain.
misc.collation_domains: Operation-specific; do not infer all collations from registration.

host.type_domains: Host primitive/binding; parameter and result types remain part of compatibility, but this family does not enter the pure-kernel denominator.
context_domains: per-row/statement/session/request host state; see exclusion reason
host.collation_domains: Host values still retain full FieldType/charset/collation.
